name: @tearleads/client-sdk
description: React-free Tearleads runtime with verified identity permalinks and read-only identity pins, pending download diagnostics, hydration-aware Explorer projections, atomic document/container writes, placement-aware persistence notifications, required revision-CAS host adapters, unified device-first handles, explicit retained-folder recovery, signed-name group mutations, verified organization policy history details without persisted names, verified keying, held-descendant re-citation, sync, encrypted blob storage, root operator identity/organization billing, data usage, ops-health, RevenueCat webhook, and audit trail lookups and identity suspension, typed suspended-account sign-in refusals, typed registration refusals, typed folder path-length refusals, typed stale keyring-override refusals, and teardown predicates for host diagnostics. Includes identity-scoped in-memory API request metrics and compact public projection authorization and paged principal-history recovery with offline evidence, strict Admins verification, authority-bound cached progress and private local key custody, including typed standalone workflow leases. Principal mutation journals require explicit signed operation kinds and retain exact compound, organization, group creation and group deletion requests across disconnects and restart. Built-in group creation, membership, grant mutations, and directory deletion author bounded current policies, return exact receipts, and retain directory-bound artifacts, progress, and typed grant retirements atomically with checkpoints. Group and organization history views load verified bounded pages. Current mutations capture sealed predecessors before submission and retain delayed receipts without regressing verified reader progress; container purges wait for moves queued in their scope. Members list every organization they hold a container of and can pause an organization's sync to their devices.
